mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN current_status='PENDING_INBOUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS pending_inbound, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN current_status='INBOUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS pending_measurement, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT label_order.id) FROM shipment_order label_order LEFT JOIN provider_order label_provider ON label_provider.tenant_id=label_order.tenant_id AND label_provider.shipment_order_id=label_order.id WHERE label_order.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND label_order.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND COALESCE(label_provider.lifecycle_status, '') <> 'LABEL_READY'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS pending_label, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM shipment_order handover_order JOIN provider_order handover_provider ON handover_provider.tenant_id=handover_order.tenant_id AND handover_provider.shipment_order_id=handover_order.id WHERE handover_order.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND handover_order.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND handover_provider.lifecycle_status='LABEL_READY'), 0) AS SIGNED) AS pending_handover, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS pending_outbound, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN current_status='IN_TRANSIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS in_transit, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking_event t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.process_status IN ('RETRY','REJECTED')), 0) AS SIGNED) AS tracking_exceptions, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.resource_type='SHIPMENT_ORDER' AND a.action_type='INBOUND' AND a.result_status='SUCCESS' AND a.occurred_at >= UTC_DATE()), 0) AS SIGNED) AS today_inbound, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.resource_type='SHIPMENT_ORDER' AND a.action_type='OUTBOUND' AND a.result_status='SUCCESS' AND a.occurred_at >= UTC_DATE()), 0) AS SIGNED) AS today_outbound FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, COALESCE(po.tracking_no, obr.tracking_no) AS tracking_no, CASE WHEN o.current_status='PENDING_INBOUND' THEN 'PENDING_INBOUND' WHEN o.current_status='INBOUND' THEN 'PENDING_MEASUREMENT' WHEN o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND po.lifecycle_status='CREATED' THEN 'PENDING_LABEL' WHEN o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND po.lifecycle_status='LABEL_READY' THEN 'PENDING_HANDOVER' WHEN o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' THEN 'PENDING_LABEL' WHEN o.current_status='IN_TRANSIT' THEN 'IN_TRANSIT' ELSE o.current_status END AS status, o.destination_country, o.chargeable_weight, CASE WHEN o.current_status='PENDING_INBOUND' THEN '确认入库' WHEN o.current_status='INBOUND' THEN '录入复称' WHEN o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND po.lifecycle_status='LABEL_READY' THEN '确认交接出库' WHEN o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' THEN '获取面单' WHEN o.current_status IN ('OUTBOUND','IN_TRANSIT') THEN '查看轨迹' ELSE '查看详情' END AS action, o.created_at FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.current_status IN ('PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','READY_FOR_OUTBOUND','OUTBOUND','IN_TRANSIT') ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, t.shipment_order_id AS order_id, o.order_no, COALESCE(po.tracking_no, obr.tracking_no) AS tracking_no, t.event_id AS exception_no, t.process_status AS status, COALESCE(t.event_description,t.process_message,'') AS description, t.event_time AS reported_at FROM tracking_event t JOIN shipment_order o ON o.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND o.id=t.shipment_order_id LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN warehouse_outbound_record obr ON obr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND obr.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.process_status IN ('RETRY','REJECTED') ORDER BY t.event_time DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
